what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1993?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 2010 report (calendar wages) and FY2011-FY2025 (fiscal). The 1993 annual town report prints no wage list: its text was searched on all 60 pages for wage, gross, earnings, payroll and salary and returned only prose in the Health and Highway reports (p12, p13), the appropriation lines for officers' salaries (p28), the omnibus lines (p37), the Article 15 longevity bylaw amendment (p38, percents of salary, no amounts per person) and the receipts line EARNINGS ON INVESTMENTS (p27) -- no list by employee (sources/data/report-tables/1993/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1993 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in 1993?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1993 annual town report prints neither: its text was searched on all 60 pages for salary schedule, classification and step; `classification` hit only the running title SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS (pp28-32) and `step` only names and prose (no grade or rate). Article 15 (p38) amends the Salary By-Law's longevity percentages only (sources/data/report-tables/1993/). — closes: the Personnel By-Law (Article XV) salary schedule in force for FY1994, from the Town Clerk.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1993, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2010 report. The 1993 annual town report prints no Inspector of Weights & Measures report: its text was searched on all 60 pages for weights, sealer and sealing and returned only the appointment (p5), the receipts line SEALING FEES $657.00 (p27), the appropriation line (p30) and the omnibus line WEIGHTS & MEASURES (p37) (sources/data/report-tables/1993/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 1993 annual report to the Division of Standards.

what: What did each item of Lunenburg's FY1994 capital plan cost?
why: `capital-plans` holds item-by-item costs. The 1993 annual town report prints no capital plan: `capital plan` occurs only in prose (p14, the Planning Board saying Capital Planning is work for FY'95; p19, the Superintendent). Capital items appear one warrant article at a time with their votes (pp37-42) and as accountant-schedule lines (pp28-32), never as a plan with a total (sources/data/report-tables/1993/). — closes: a Capital Planning Committee plan for FY1994, if one existed; the Planning Board's p14 report suggests the committee's work began later.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed value by property class in fiscal 1993 and 1994, with the levy, the overlay and new growth?
why: `report-valuation` holds the assessors' tables (assessments by class, tax and levy history, overlay, new growth) from the 2001 and 2010 reports. The 1993 annual town report prints only two totals and a rate inside ABOUT THE TOWN (p3: `ASSESSED VALUATION: $453,870,017 - Real Estate / $11,705,918 - Personal Prop.`, no date given; `TAX RATE: $15.19 (Fiscal 1994)`) and the Board of Assessors' prose (pp6-7). Its text was searched on all 60 pages for valuation, levy, overlay and new growth: `levy`, `overlay` and `new growth` returned nothing (sources/data/report-tables/1993/). — closes: the Assessors' fiscal 1994 tax rate recapitulation (Form RECAP) and LA-4 by class, from DLS or the Board of Assessors.

what: How much of Lunenburg's debt at 30 June 1993 sat inside the debt limit, and how much outside it?
why: `outstanding-debt` reads this from the five-year outstanding-debt summary the FY2011-FY2025 reports print. The 1993 annual town report prints its bonded indebtedness issue by issue (p53) and a repayment schedule (p54) whose interest lines carry `(EXEMPTED)` for three issues (two ELEMENTARY SCHOOL REMODELING, one MUNICIPAL PURPOSE) -- an exemption from Proposition 2 1/2, not a debt-limit split -- but no summary inside/outside the limit: `debt limit` and `levy` returned nothing on any of the 60 pages (sources/data/report-tables/1993/). — closes: the Town's FY1993 Statement of Indebtedness as filed with the Division of Local Services.
